description: Rules that keep application SQL and migrations portable between SQLite and PostgreSQL. tests/database-portability enforces the checkable ones.

rules.rule: Application queries use SQLAlchemy Core expressions, never raw dialect SQL.
Every migration version that has a dialect-specific file has one for both sqlite and postgres.
Files in migrations/common use only portable SQL: plain INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE, TRUE/FALSE literals, no RETURNING, no ON CONFLICT, no identity/autoincrement syntax.
Both dialects end up with the same tables and the same columns per table.
The tables and columns in data-model/model.json match the migrated schema.
Store timestamps in UTC; never rely on the database session time zone.
Do not depend on string length enforcement by the database; validate in the API.
Avoid database-generated values other than primary keys; set timestamps in the application.
Use lower() on both sides for case-insensitive matches instead of ILIKE or COLLATE NOCASE.
